errors.evidence: Description states BLEU as 28.0 at α = 0.1, but the atom (alpha_01_bleu) specifies 28.00, which is correct but redundant to flag. However, the peak value for α = 0.5 is incorrectly reported as 28.54 instead of 28.55.
Description reports the peak BLEU value for α = 0.5 as 28.54, but the figure and atom (alpha_05_bleu) show 28.55.
Description reports BLEU as 28.1 at α = 0.9, but the figure and atom (alpha_09_bleu) show 28.12.
Description states BLEU as 28.0 at p = 0.05, but the figure and atom (p_005_bleu) show 28.30.
Description reports the peak BLEU value for p = 0.15 as 28.53, but the figure and atom (p_015_bleu) show 28.55.
Description reports BLEU as 28.41 at p = 0.25, but the figure and atom (p_025_bleu) show 28.38.
Description reports BLEU as 28.45 at p = 0.35, but the figure and atom (p_035_bleu) show 28.44.
Description reports BLEU as 28.44 at p = 0.45, but the figure and atom (p_045_bleu) show 28.40.
The description omits the y-axis range upper limit of 28.6, only mentioning up to 28.5.
The description does not explicitly state that the trend for α shows a clear peak at 0.5, only describing it as '先上升后下降'.
The description does not mention that the impact of p on BLEU scores is slightly smaller than that of α.
The description omits the overall finding that optimal hyperparameter settings yield the best BLEU scores.
